title: hieracium praecox subsp. basalticum
intro: Hieracium praecox subsp. basalticum, commonly known as Rough Hawk's-beard, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Rough Hawk's-beard include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties, which make it useful for wound healing and skin issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
